description: Replacement of the existing single-glazed windows and doors with new double-glazed timber windows and doors to match the existing on the front and rear elevations.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span class="gmail_default" style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">Prior to the installation of any replacement windows or doors, detailed drawings and specifications shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The details shall include:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">a) Elevations of all proposed windows and doors at a scale of not less than 1:20.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">b) Sections through the proposed windows, doors, frames, toplights (for door) and associated masonry surrounds at a scale of not less than 1:5.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">c) Details of all materials and finishes including glazing thickness, glazing bars, sash horns, mullions, putty/bead profiles, opening mechanisms and any ventilation measures.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">d) Details demonstrating that any trickle vents are concealed within the window or door frames and are not visible externally.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The replacement windows and doors shall match the existing building in respect of materials, design, dimensions, profiles, method of opening, detailed execution and finished appearance, and shall be installed only in accordance with the approved details.</span></p><p><strong style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">REASON:</span></strong><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="font-size: 14px;"> </span><span style="font-size: 14px;">To ensure a high quality design and to preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.</span></span></p>
